articles.title: IN BRIEF: Putin's meeting on Konstantinovka liberation, special military operation course
articles.summary: Putin held a meeting at a military command post where he was briefed on Russian military operations, including the liberation of Konstantinovka and territorial gains in the special military operation.

articles.title: Fighters of Battlegroup North continue to push Ukraine away from Russian borders — Putin
articles.summary: Putin noted that the North battlegroup continues to move Ukrainian formations away from Russian borders and emphasized the importance of creating a security strip on the border.

articles.title: Russia standing firm on its feet, ready to fight for its core interests — Putin
articles.summary: Putin addressed a United Russia party congress, stating that Russia is standing firm and ready to defend its fundamental interests and sovereign ideology.

articles.title: Russia living through crucial time — Putin
articles.summary: Putin stated at a United Russia party congress that Russia is living through a crucial time as the country and world undergo radical systemic transformation.
